import {
  Body,
  Container,
  Head,
  Heading,
  Html,
  Link,
  Preview,
  Section,
  Text,
} from '@react-email/components'
import { render } from '@react-email/components'

export interface StaffInviteLinkEmailProps {
  inviteUrl: string
  appName?: string
  expiresIn?: string
}

export function StaffInviteLinkEmail({
  inviteUrl,
  appName = 'CampOS',
  expiresIn = '7 days',
}: StaffInviteLinkEmailProps) {
  return (
    <Html>
      <Head />
      <Preview>You're invited to join a property on {appName}</Preview>
      <Body style={main}>
        <Container style={container}>
          <Section style={inner}>
            <Heading style={h1}>You're invited</Heading>
            <Text style={intro}>
              A property on {appName} added you as staff. Click the button below
              to create your password and activate your account.
            </Text>
            <Section style={buttonSection}>
              <Link href={inviteUrl} style={button}>
                Complete registration
              </Link>
            </Section>
            <Text style={linkLabel}>
              Or copy and paste this link into your browser:
            </Text>
            <Text style={linkUrl}>{inviteUrl}</Text>
            <Text style={footer}>
              This link expires in {expiresIn}. If you didn't expect this
              invitation, you can ignore this email.
            </Text>
          </Section>
        </Container>
      </Body>
    </Html>
  )
}

export default StaffInviteLinkEmail

export async function buildStaffInviteLinkEmailHtml(
  inviteUrl: string,
  appName = 'CampOS',
  expiresIn?: string,
): Promise<string> {
  return render(
    StaffInviteLinkEmail({
      inviteUrl,
      appName,
      ...(expiresIn !== undefined && { expiresIn }),
    }),
  )
}

---

## Staff Invitation & Password Setup Flow — Complete Scout Report

### 1. Complete File Map

| Layer | File | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| **Invite API** | `src/app/api/v1/properties/[propertyId]/staff-management/invite-staff/route.ts` | Creates auth user + token + property_staff row + sends email |
| **Register API (GET)** | `src/app/api/auth/staff-invite-register/route.ts` | Validates token, returns invite context |
| **Register API (POST)** | `src/app/api/auth/staff-invite-register/route.ts` | Sets password, confirms email, activates staff |
| **Password Setup Page** | `src/app/(auth)/staff-invite/page.tsx` | Frontend form for name, phone, password |
| **Email Template** | `src/lib/email/templates/staff-invite-link.tsx` | React Email HTML template |
| **Email Sender (SMTP)** | `src/lib/email/emailit.ts` | Nodemailer SMTP transport |
| **Email Sender (Resend)** | `src/lib/email/resend.ts` | Resend API client (alternate provider) |
| **Invite Dialog UI** | `src/components/dashboard/staff-management/staff-management-dialog/invite-staff-dialog.tsx` | Admin form: email, role, categories |
| **Staff Table** | `src/components/dashboard/staff-management/staff-management-table.tsx` | Shows all staff with status pills |
| **Staff Details Dialog** | `src/components/dashboard/staff-management/staff-management-dialog/staff-details-dialog.tsx` | Read-only view with status pill |
| **Staff Queries** | `src/lib/dashboard/staff-management-queries.ts` | `inviteStaff()`, `activatePendingStaffForUser()`, `getStaffInviteStaffContextByUserId()` |
| **Staff List API** | `src/app/api/v1/properties/[propertyId]/staff-management/staff/route.ts` | GET endpoint for staff table |
| **Activity Log** | `src/shared/activity-log/record-activity-log.ts` | Records staff invite events |
| **RBAC Guards** | `src/lib/rbac/dashboard-guards.ts` | `canManageStaffRoster()` — admin-only |
| **Login Page** | `src/app/(auth)/login/page.tsx` | Deactivation check on login |
| **Dashboard Layout** | `src/app/dashboard/layout.tsx` | Ejects inactive staff from dashboard |

---

### 2. Token Generation, Storage & Validation

**Generation** (`invite-staff/route.ts:21-25,169-189`):
- Token: `randomBytes(32).toString('hex')` — 64-char hex string
- Token is **never stored in plaintext** — only SHA-256 hash stored in `app_metadata`
- Token hash key: `staff_invite_token_hash` in Supabase Auth `app_metadata`
- Expiry: `staff_invite_expires_at` — ISO timestamp, **7 days** from creation (`STAFF_INVITE_TOKEN_EXPIRY_DAYS = 7`)
- Sent-at: `staff_invite_sent_at` — ISO timestamp of when invite was sent

**Validation** (`staff-invite-register/route.ts:14-32`):
```
validateStaffInviteToken(appMetadata, token):
  1. Check storedHash and expiresAt exist in app_metadata
  2. Check expiresAt > (now - 60s buffer)   → 'expired'
  3. SHA-256(input token) === storedHash    → 'invalid_link'
  4. Return { valid: true }
```
- 60-second `EXPIRY_BUFFER_MS` grace period on expiry
- **Token is single-use**: After successful password set, `staff_invite_token_hash` is set to `null` and `staff_invite_expires_at` to `null` (line 177)

**Storage location**: Supabase Auth `app_metadata` — NOT in the database. There is no `invited_at`, `accepted_at`, or `invitation_status` column in `property_staff`.

---

### 3. Email Flow

**Template** (`src/lib/email/templates/staff-invite-link.tsx`):
- Subject: `"You're invited to CampOS — complete your registration"`
- HTML: React Email component with gradient CTA button, link URL, expiry notice
- Preview text: `"You're invited to join a property on CampOS"`
- Footer: "This link expires in 7 days. If you didn't expect this invitation, you can ignore this email."

**Sending** (`invite-staff/route.ts:220-235`):
- Uses `sendEmail()` from `src/lib/email/emailit.ts` (Nodemailer SMTP)
- Also sends a plaintext fallback with the same URL
- URL format: `{baseUrl}/staff-invite?token={token}&uid={userId}`
- Base URL from `NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL` || `NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_URL` || `localhost:3000`

**Two email providers exist**: `emailit.ts` (SMTP via Nodemailer) and `resend.ts` (Resend API). Only `emailit.ts` is used by the invite flow. `resend.ts` appears unused by this flow.

---

### 4. Password Setup Page

**Route**: `/staff-invite?token={token}&uid={uid}` → `src/app/(auth)/staff-invite/page.tsx`

**Flow**:
1. Page loads → validates token via `GET /api/auth/staff-invite-register?token=...&uid=...`
2. If valid → shows form pre-filled with email (disabled), firstName, lastName, contactPhone (editable), role + categories (read-only badges)
3. If invalid/expired → shows "Link invalid or expired" card with Go to Login button
4. On submit (`POST /api/auth/staff-invite-register`):
   - Client-side validates: first/last name required, password match, min 8 chars
   - Server-side validates same + token validation
   - Sets password, confirms email (`email_confirm: true`), saves name/phone in `user_metadata`
   - Clears token from `app_metadata` (single-use)
   - Calls `activatePendingStaffForUser(uid)` — sets `property_staff.status = 'active'`
   - Redirects to `/login?staff_invite=success`

**Post-registration redirect gap**: The login page (`src/app/(auth)/login/page.tsx`) handles `reset=success` and `reason=staff_deactivated` search params, but does **NOT** handle `staff_invite=success`. The user is redirected to the login page but sees no success message — the parameter is silently ignored.

---

### 5. Invitation Status Tracking

**There is no dedicated invitation tracking.** The system uses the `property_staff.status` column with three values:

| Status | Meaning | When set |
|---|---|---|
| `pending` | Invited but hasn't set password yet | On invite creation (`inviteStaff()` with `status: 'pending'`) |
| `active` | Password set, account activated | On successful password setup via `activatePendingStaffForUser()` |
| `inactive` | Deactivated by admin | On deactivation via `deactivatePropertyStaffAssignment()` |

**What's NOT tracked**:
- ❌ No `invited_at` timestamp column
- ❌ No `accepted_at` timestamp column
- ❌ No `invitation_status` field separate from `property_staff.status`
- ❌ No `Expired` status — expired invitations remain as `pending` forever
- ❌ No distinction between "never opened" and "opened but didn't complete"
- ❌ No record of how many times an invite email was sent
- ❌ No automatic status transition from `pending` → `expired`

The only timestamps are in Supabase Auth `app_metadata`: `staff_invite_sent_at` and `staff_invite_expires_at` — accessible only via the Admin API, not through standard queries.

**Status display**: The staff management table shows status as color-coded pills:
- Active: green (`border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50`)
- Pending: amber (`border-amber-200 bg-amber-50`)
- Inactive: muted gray

---

### 6. Resend Invitation Feature

**Resend does NOT exist.** There is:
- ❌ No `/api/v1/.../resend-invite` or similar endpoint
- ❌ No "Resend Invitation" button in any UI component
- ❌ No `resend-invite` route handler anywhere in the codebase
- ❌ No logic to regenerate a token for an existing pending staff member

The only reference to "resend" in the context of invitations is in error messages telling users to "ask your property admin to resend the invite" — but the admin has no way to actually do this.

**Workaround**: An admin could delete the pending staff member and re-invite, but there's no delete-staff API exposed either. The current flow only allows creating new invites.

---

### 7. Audit Trail

The invite flow **does** record activity log entries (`invite-staff/route.ts:207-236`):

1. **Staff creation**: `{ action: 'create', resource: 'staff', details: 'Invited staff {email} with role {role}.' }`
2. **Email sent**: `{ action: 'create', resource: 'staff_invite_email', details: 'System sent staff invite email to {email}.' }`

Both entries include `companyId`, `propertyId`, and `userId` (the admin who invited).

**What's NOT logged**:
- ❌ Token validation failures
- ❌ Password set completion (no activity log entry when staff member accepts invite)
- ❌ Expiration events

### 8. Edge Cases & Risks

| Risk | Details |
|---|---|
| **No resend capability** | If an invite email is lost/spammed, there is no way for an admin to resend it. The only option is to delete and re-invite, but no delete-staff API exists for pending invites. |
| **No expiration enforcement** | Pending staff remain as `pending` indefinitely. There is no cron job, trigger, or background process to mark expired invitations. |
| **No "Expired" status** | The task description mentions tracking `Expired` status, but this does not exist in the codebase. |
| **Login page ignores success redirect** | `staff_invite=success` param is not handled by login page — user gets no confirmation message. |
| **Token stored only in app_metadata** | If Supabase Auth metadata is wiped or the user is recreated, the token is lost permanently. |
| **Single-property assumption** | `findAuthUserIdByEmail()` searches all users. If the email already exists anywhere in the system (even on a different property), the invite is blocked with "This email already exists". |
| **No duplicate invite guard** | If an admin tries to invite the same email to the same property, the duplicate is caught by `findAuthUserIdByEmail` returning the existing user ID, but the error message says "This email already exists" — doesn't clarify it's already invited to this property. |
| **Password set but activation fails** | If `activatePendingStaffForUser()` throws after password is set, the user has a working password but `property_staff.status` stays `pending`. The error response tells them to contact support. |
| **No rate limiting** on invite endpoint | An admin could mass-invite many emails without throttling. |
| **Token in URL** | The invite link contains a raw token in the query string. This is visible in browser history, server logs, and referrer headers. The token is long (64 hex chars) which provides reasonable entropy, but it's not a one-time-use short-lived opaque token. |
| **7-day expiry** | The task description says "24–72 hour expiration" but the implementation uses **7 days** (`STAFF_INVITE_TOKEN_EXPIRY_DAYS = 7`). |
| **No email verification before invite** | The invite flow creates a Supabase Auth user with `email_confirm: false`, so email is unverified until the invite link is used. |

| Requirement | Status | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Trigger email on staff account creation | ✅ Implemented | Via `sendEmail()` using SMTP |
| Secure password reset link | ✅ Implemented | SHA-256 hashed token, 64 hex chars |
| 24–72 hour expiration | ⚠️ Mismatch | Implemented as **7 days**, not 24–72h |
| Link redirects to frontend page | ✅ Implemented | `/staff-invite?token=...&uid=...` |
